title: UN Global Compact Launches Ireland Network to Drive Sustainable Business Leadership
description: The United Nations Global Compact launched its Ireland Network, bringing together over 150 senior leaders from Ireland's business community to advance sustainability and the UN Sustainable Development Goals. The event featured keynote speeches, panel discussions, and the exploration of the Forward Faster initiative, which urges businesses to accelerate action in areas like gender equality, sustainable finance, and climate action.

title: Snack Food Packaging Market to Reach USD 28.5 Billion by 2035, Driven by Demand for Savory Snack Packaging | Future Market Insights, Inc.
description: The global snack food packaging industry is projected to grow from $19.5 billion in 2025 to $28.5 billion by 2035, driven by increasing demand for specialized packaging for savory snacks. Key factors include the need to preserve texture, flavor, and crispiness, as well as rising consumer preference for convenience foods and evolving packaging expectations.
